Image Placeholders Required
===========================

Please add the following images to the /public folder:

1. avatar.jpg (or avatar.png)
   - Portrait photo for the hero section
   - Recommended size: 243x243px minimum
   - Should be a professional headshot

2. work-1.jpg
   - Thumbnail for "Designing Dashboards" project
   - Recommended size: 246x184px

3. work-2.jpg
   - Thumbnail for "Vibrant Portraits of 2020" project
   - Recommended size: 246x184px

4. work-3.jpg
   - Thumbnail for "36 Days of Malayalam type" project
   - Recommended size: 246x184px

All images will be referenced from the /public folder, so place them directly here.
